title: QUIC RFC 9000 Server Pre-Acceptance Ingress Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S5P2P2 requirement-home tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers server-side pre-acceptance classification and admission for unmatched datagrams: Version Negotiation eligibility and limiting, undersized unsupported-version drops, supported-version routing by connection ID or zero-length local tuple, conforming Initial admission, premature Handshake ignores, and generic unmatched-packet drops.
expected_result: The focused requirement-home tests show unsupported versions are answered only when large enough and not limited, smaller unsupported-version packets are dropped, supported-version packets route by CID, zero-length-CID packets require local address and port matching, a protected conforming Initial proceeds far enough to emit a server Initial response, premature Handshake packets are ignored, and unmatched short-header packets are dropped.
procedure: Run the focused S5P2P2 requirement-home filter for requirements 0001, 0002, 0003, 0004, 0005, 0006, 0009, and 0010.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: Endpoint ingress routing remains the first receive-loop decision before listener pre-acceptance policy.
The listener remains server-only for this slice.
The existing protected Initial builder can create a conforming client Initial for loopback listener proof.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim CONNECTION_REFUSED policy, 0-RTT buffering, client-side Version Negotiation handling, client-side Initial/Retry CID continuity, preferred-address behavior, public API changes, or broader interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S5P2P2 requirement-home filter passed 14/14, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks S5P2P2 0001 through 0006 and 0009 through 0010 trace_clean while leaving 0007 and 0008 out of scope, SpecTrace core validation passed, and git diff --check passed.
